headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: The Elite vs. Death Triangle met in a Best of 7 Series, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.95 ? a solid showing.
Rewind to 2024, when Daniel Garcia vs. Kazuchika Okada met in a Continental Classic League Match, serving as the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.36 ? a good, competitive contest.
Flash back to 2024, when Private Party & Mistico kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.60.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Bryan Danielson vs. Dax Harwood locked horns for the first time, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 7.95 ? a strong outing.
Back on this day in 2022, Samoa Joe vs. AR Fox went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.23. For AR Fox, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
Looking back to 2024, when Will Ospreay vs. Juice Robinson met in a Continental Classic League Match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 6.65.
